name: Spotify
description: Now playing, queue, recently played, and transport controls for Spotify. Client ID + refresh token from a one-time OAuth flow are stored encrypted; widgets and wallpapers call iappyx.plugin('spotify').* without seeing them.
author: iappyx
aiPrompt: iappyx.plugin('spotify') wraps the Spotify Web API. User configures Client ID + refresh token via Settings → Plugins → Spotify → Configure (one-time OAuth dance). Plugin handles access-token refresh automatically. All methods return Promises; check {ok}. nowPlaying() → {ok, isPlaying:bool, track:{id, name, artists:[{name}], album:{name, artUrl}, durationMs, progressMs, isLocal}, device:{id, name, type, volumePercent}} — returns {ok:true, isPlaying:false, track:null} when nothing is playing. playbackState() → richer version of nowPlaying including shuffle/repeat state. queue() → {ok, current, queue:[track,…]}. recentlyPlayed({count:20}) → {ok, items:[{track, playedAt}]}. devices() → {ok, devices:[{id, name, type, isActive, volumePercent}]} including all the user's connected Spotify Connect endpoints. Transport controls (Premium required): play({uri, deviceId}) plays a Spotify URI (e.g. 'spotify:track:...', 'spotify:playlist:...', 'spotify:album:...'); pause(), resume(), next(), previous(), seek({positionMs}), setVolume({percent, deviceId}). All replies follow {ok:true} or {ok:false, error:'…'}. Best widgets: 'now playing' card with album art (track.album.artUrl is a CDN URL — drop into ), 'tap to skip', 'queue preview', 'top device picker'. Best wallpapers: extract the dominant colour from artUrl and pulse the wallpaper with it, particle visualiser that reacts to progressMs/durationMs.
